about: The Blender asset pipeline's registry (D-305). One entry per generated asset: the node script that writes its source meshes from the project's own data (numbers before pictures: no geometry is drawn by hand in Blender), the files and values whose hash decides whether the asset is stale, the bake settings, the per-level texture sizes and the budgets tests/blender_assets.test.ts holds it to. `node tools/blender/build.mjs` regenerates every asset; public/models/manifest.json records each build (input hash, output hash, measured counts).

capital_protome.title: double-bull protome of the bull and composite capitals (Apadana, Gate of All Nations, Tachara, Hadish, Hall of 100 Columns, Harem)

source.args_note: cell 0.005 D (half the game's LOD0 marching-cubes cell, sculpture.json protome.mc.cell 0.01: the grooves of eyes, horns' joints and locks span 2-4 cells); lock template 1500 triangles (the game's LOD0 carries 64: the spiral groove needs ~1000 to read as a groove). Technical, C

capital_protome.lods_note: the game's two levels (sculpture.json lod.switch.column 32 m). 1024 px over LOD0: ~1.1 cm per texel on the Apadana's protome (5.6 m wide), below a pixel at 5 m at the player's lens; 256 px for LOD1 (seen beyond 32 m)
capital_protome.bake_note: units: the source's (D, the column's lower shaft diameter). cage 0.03 D and rays 0.06 D cover the LOD0 simplification error (<= 1 cell); AO rays 0.2 D (32 cm on the Apadana) see the carving's own hollows (eye sockets, the gap under the forelegs, between the locks), not the building
capital_protome.budget_note: triangles: sculpture.json protome.mc lod0/lod1 (the game's own budget, unchanged: the bake adds maps, not triangles); GLB <= 2.6 MB of the 60 MB first-load budget (T-K7); GPU <= 8 MB of the 3.5 GB (T-K8): PNG maps decode to RGBA8 (5.6 MB + 0.35 MB with mips), KTX2 UASTC would be a quarter
